agreement_date.description: The date the agreement is made, from the opening line, as YYYY-MM-DD

management.description: The owner's authorized agent named as Management

property.description: The leased property, from Term and Description

unit_number.description: The unit number, or null if blank

address.description: The property address as written after 'located at'

lease_type.description: 'fixed' if the fixed-term box is checked, 'month-to-month' if the periodic box is checked

length.description: The length of the term as written, e.g. '12 Months'

start_date.description: The date the term commences, as YYYY-MM-DD

end_date.description: The date the term ends, as YYYY-MM-DD

rent.description: Rent and charges, from the Rent section

due_day.description: The calendar day of each month rent is due, as written, e.g. '1st'

late_charge.description: The late charge for rent paid late, in dollars

late_after_day.description: The calendar day after which the late charge applies, as written, e.g. '5th'

insufficient_funds_fee.description: The service fee for insufficient funds, in dollars

security_deposit.description: The security deposit received from the tenant, in dollars, from the Security Deposit section

signatures.description: Every signature line on the signature page, whether signed or not

role.description: The role printed under the line, e.g. 'Tenant' or 'Management/Agent'

is_signed.description: True if the signature line carries a signature

printed_name.description: The printed name for this signature line, or null if blank
